name: changelog-studio
description: Turn raw git commits into polished, categorized release notes.
author: Mykyta Belimenko

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @changelog-studio/api" "npm run dev -w @changelog-studio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @changelog-studio/api && npm run build -w @changelog-studio/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @changelog-studio/shared && npm run test -w @changelog-studio/api
